sentences.text:
Raju Adhikary & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 16
May, 2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri

Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
16.05.2023 Sl. No.71.
D/L. Mithun.
Ct.No.42.

Ia No: Cran/2/2023 In Crr/3040/2022 Raju Adhikary & Ors.
Vs.
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Rajdeep Mazumder, Mr. Pritam Roy, Mr. Abhijit Singh.
Mr. Arka Tilak Bhadra, Mr. Subhajit Chowdhury, ...for opposite party No.2.

Mr. Sudip Ghosh, Mr.
Bitasok Banerjee.
Affidavit of service be taken on record.
Private opposite party has already entered appearance.
The State of West Bengal is also represented by Mr. Banerjee, learned Advocate.

It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the State that in connection with Barrackpore Women's Police Station Case No.39 of 2022 dated 16th July, 2022, the Investigating Officer has already filed charge sheet under Sections 498A/406/506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Since the contesting parties have already entered appearance, the instant revisional application be listed under the heading "For Orders" in the Monthly List of July, 2023.
Interim order of stay in the form of no coercive step shall continue till 31st July, 2023.
The application is, thus, disposed of.
